Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
query_count number:=0;
dup_skill number:=0;
dup_skill2 number:=0;
ins_flg number:=0;
v_date date;
begin
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 nullchk ; check_package_failure ; 
 if(:employee_jobs.job_code <> 'OVRAL') then
 select count(*) into query_count 
 from valid_master_codes where code_type='JOBTY' and
 code = :employee_jobs.job_code and
 v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1)
 and rownum = 1;
 if (query_count = 0) then
 show_error('12013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 /*** check for duplicates ***/

/* Check duplicates in the database */
 
 select count(*) into dup_skill 
 from employee_jobs where staff_no = :employee_jobs.staff_no 
 and job_code = :employee_jobs.job_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1)
 and rownum = 1;
 if(dup_skill = 1) then
 show_error('12028');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;




 if ((:employee_jobs.old_job_code is null) or
 (:employee_jobs.old_job_code is not null and
 :employee_jobs.old_job_code != :employee_jobs.job_code)) then

 for i in 1..get_group_row_count('RG_SKILL') loop 
 if get_group_char_cell('RG_SKILL.JOB_CODE',i) = :employee_jobs.job_code then
 show_error('12028');
 check_package_failure;
 end if ;
 end loop ;

 for i in 1..get_group_row_count('RG_SKILL') loop 
 if get_group_char_cell('RG_SKILL.JOB_CODE',i) = :employee_jobs.old_job_code then
 delete_group_row('RG_SKILL',i) ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 add_group_row('RG_SKILL',END_OF_GROUP) ;
 set_group_char_cell('RG_SKILL.JOB_CODE',
 get_group_row_count('RG_SKILL'),
 :employee_jobs.job_code);
 end if ;

 
 if (:employee_jobs.job_code = 'VDRVR') then
 :employee_jobs.job_desc := 'Van Driver';
 elsif (:employee_jobs.job_code = 'CDRVR') then
 :employee_jobs.job_desc := 'Coach Driver';
 elsif (:employee_jobs.job_code = 'OVRAL') then
 :employee_jobs.job_desc := 'Overall Rating';
 else
 select substr(description,1,20)
 into :employee_jobs.job_desc
 from valid_master_codes where code_type='JOBTY' and
 code = :employee_jobs.job_code and
 rownum=1;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := 'RG_SKILL'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 v_local_time date;
 v_sysdate varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '02';
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM# 2134
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- Sysdate conversion
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- Sysdate conversion for eff_date validation
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- IM 5367--Fixed issue with staff_no validation
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM 6210
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM 8723; 06/05/12; Modified LOV for Staff No and WVI of staff number. (timezone conversion added).
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- IM 8497
 --:global.program_version := '10'; -- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';
 
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER('util_banner');
 set_item_property('toolbar.enter_query',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.cancel_query',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 /*-- Create the record group for checking duplicate ---*/

 /*-- Make sure the record group does not already exist. --*/

 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 

 /*-- If it does not exist, create it and add the columns STAFF_NO and JOB_CODE --*/

 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'JOB_CODE',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 ELSE
 delete_group_row(rg_id,ALL_ROWS) ;
 END IF; 

 -- time zone change --04/14/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :global.v_sysdate := to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 :global.v_sysdate := to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PROC_DEL_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE proc_del_rg IS
 i_rows number ;
BEGIN

 i_rows := get_group_row_count('RG_SKILL') ;

 for counter in 1..i_rows loop
 if get_group_char_cell('RG_SKILL.STAFF_NO',counter) = :employee_jobs.staff_no and
 get_group_char_cell('RG_SKILL.JOB_CODE',counter) = :employee_jobs.job_code then
 delete_group_row('RG_SKILL',counter) ;
 exit ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;

END;

query_count number:=0;

 END IF;
 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
